# RouteRush

> RouteRush ("RouteRush: Run & Conquer" on the App Store) is an iOS app that turns running and cycling into territorial conquest: close a loop on a run and the streets inside it become your territory. Territory follows the streets you ran on a 3D city map and earns Rush Points, which rank you in weekly leagues of up to thirty runners. Anyone who closes a loop over your ground takes the overlap; until then it stays yours.

- Platform: iPhone only, iOS 18 or later. No Android version; Apple Watch app coming soon. Strava, Garmin and other apps work via Apple Health: runs and rides from the last 90 days import to a private map, claiming no territory. Recorded runs save to Apple Health.
- Free to download and play: GPS tracking, territory, leagues, clubs, challenges and every training plan.
- Boldi, the AI running coach: Pro includes text chat and one coached run a month; Ultra coaches every run and adds voice conversations between runs.
- Free training plans: Get Started (four weeks), 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon, plus weekly and monthly challenges.
- Clubs (optionally invite-only), club battles, and running and cycling events nearby.
- Made by a solo indie developer in Turin, Italy.
